windows.command: if (Get-Command pio -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue) { pio run } else { & "$env:USERPROFILE\.platformio\penv\Scripts\pio.exe" run }
if (Get-Command pio -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue) { pio run --target upload } else { & "$env:USERPROFILE\.platformio\penv\Scripts\pio.exe" run --target upload }
if (Get-Command pio -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue) { pio device monitor } else { & "$env:USERPROFILE\.platformio\penv\Scripts\pio.exe" device monitor }
if (Get-Command pio -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue) { pio run --target upload --target monitor } else { & "$env:USERPROFILE\.platformio\penv\Scripts\pio.exe" run --target upload --target monitor }
